title: 第116章 福王来了！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 听到这话，不仅唐逸懵了，所有人也都懵了。　　所有人都以为会见到兄弟俩在才华上交锋，在诗词上决雌雄，那才是小诗仙和三元及第的状元该有的战场！　　可谁都没想到，竟然会是这么个转折。　　顷刻间，所有人的目光，都齐齐落在唐逸的身上，错愕中带着震撼，带着原来如此的释然。　　唐画的意思，唐逸这两首《钗头凤》，是抄袭他的诗词？　　这……这也太劲爆了吧？　　炎文帝猛地站了起来，脸上也是充满错愕和震惊。　　太子，刘温，赵柯等人也都瞪大眼睛，呼吸渐渐急促起来。　　如果这是真的，那就不是在炎文帝脸上甩巴掌，而是直接将他按在脚下啪啪乱踩啊！　　皇帝最看重的小诗仙，诗词竟然都是抄袭的，这可是惊天丑闻。　　唯独唐敬，此时已经瞪大双眼，抚着长须的手已经僵在了下巴。　　他也完全没想到，唐画竟然选择以这样的方式和唐逸交锋，这让他的心头失望的同时，忽然升起了浓浓的不安。　　唐画这几日都是他亲自辅导和监督，并且亲自押题写诗词，他很清楚唐画根本就没写过这两首词。　　孔诗岚俏脸也是瞬间大变，被唐画的话给震撼到了。　　要是唐画说的是真的，那今日胜者将会是唐画……不，不对，题目是她临时想出来的，今日上台的时候才确定的题目，唐画怎么会先写出诗词？　　难不成唐画还能未卜先知？　　她下意识看向唐逸，却见唐逸嘴角笑容带着浓浓的玩味和嘲讽。　　见到唐逸的表情，不知为何孔诗岚忽然就心安了。　　“唐画啊唐画，看来我还是太高看你了，你的手段居然就这么的低级。”　　唐逸抱着双手，居高临下睨着唐画：“恶人先告状这一套，你还真是屡试不爽啊！抄袭？我他妈的还没追究你抄袭我，你倒是先咬上我了是吧？”　　唐画听到这话，却是冷笑一声，半点不慌。　　他冲着炎文帝的方向拱了拱手，道：“我是陛下钦点的三元及第的状元，我还需要抄袭你？”　　话落，他猛地指着唐逸，声音拔高了几分。　　“而你，却在几日前我押孔小姐题写诗词的时候，偷拿我的手稿，在这里大放厥词，你……才是抄袭者！”　　听到这话，全场瞬间就沸腾了！　　“什么？这两首诗词竟然是唐逸抄袭的？”　　“草，那我下台干嘛？老子居然向一个抄袭者认输？”　　“抄袭无耻，什么小诗仙，简直就是我大炎文坛的耻辱。”　　“特妈的，你们说什么呢？小诗仙会抄袭，老子看你们脑袋是坏掉了。”　　“呸，我哥哥才不会抄袭，抄袭是小狗！”　　“……”　　原本很多人对唐逸就不服，现在有了宣泄口，怒火瞬间全部向唐逸宣泄过来。　　有人在指责，在怒骂，在诅咒，当然老将军狄苍等人也跳了出来，帮唐逸说话，撸着袖子力战全场……　　场面一时间大乱！　　就连看戏的龙斩，这时候脸色都有些僵硬，这戏有意思啊！主打的就是一个意想不到，哈哈哈……　　秦钰和宇文封站在舞台上，彼此相视一眼，两人都忽然觉得自己有些多余了。　　要不，你们先打完？　　你们先打完我们再继续！　　炎文帝看着这一幕，炎文帝都有些懵，原本稳赢的局，怎么忽然就成大杂烩了？　　“够了！都给朕闭嘴。”　　他沉喝一声。　　原本喧嚣的鹿鸣湖，这才渐渐安静了下来。　　炎文帝目光看向唐逸，没好气道：“他说你抄袭？怎么回事？”　　唐逸抄袭，他是半个字都不信。　　唐逸给他和老将军写过诗，那都是他们临时出的题，唐逸也当场写出了他们满意的诗，你管这叫抄袭？　　唐逸对上炎文帝的视线，耸耸肩道：“怎么回事？输不起呗。”　　“他之前殿试的那篇《劝谏诗》，就是抄袭我的诗。”　　“但他凭借这首诗，让陛下钦点他为三元及第的状元，然后，他就仗着这状元的身份，有恃无恐地诬陷我抄袭。”　　“毕竟，一个没名没分的小诗仙，和一个三元及第陛下钦点的状元，平常人一眼就知道该相信谁。”　　唐逸声音平静，然而他的话落在场中，却宛若惊雷。　　什么？！　　唐画才是真正的抄袭者？　　他参加殿试的《劝谏诗》，竟然是抄袭唐逸的？　　这……这比唐逸抄袭还劲爆啊！　　“唐逸，你给我闭嘴！”　　唐敬瞬间站了起来，指着唐逸怒斥。　　“唐逸小贼，休得胡说！”　　“放肆，你这是公然诬陷。”　　“唐逸，当日唐画所作《劝谏诗》我们都在场，怎么可能是抄袭！”　　“……”　　刘温，赵柯等一众大臣，也都齐齐站了起来，冲着唐逸破口大骂。　　唐逸抄袭唐画，那是惊天丑闻，他们乐见其成，毕竟那打的是炎文帝的脸。　　但要是唐画抄袭唐逸，那就不是丑闻了，那是要死人的啊！　　当日唐画所作《劝谏诗》，他们可都借着这首诗，几乎骑在炎文帝的脸上输出，气得炎文帝暴跳如雷。　　现在要是确定这首诗是抄袭的……　　呵呵，那他们估计得排着队，和皇帝玩唐逸所说的什么九族消消乐了。　　炎文帝看着急眼的一众大臣，又看了眼唐画，他瞬间就相信了唐逸的话！　　想到当日殿试上，被一首《劝谏诗》劈头盖脸骂一顿，炎文帝心头瞬间被怒火充斥，眼中意识杀意凛然。　　“唐逸，你说……《劝谏诗》是抄袭的，可有证据？”　　炎文帝盯着唐逸，一字一句。　　听到这话，唐画看向唐逸的目光，顿时都戏谑起来。　　证据？你有吗？你想自证清白？可能吗？　　却见唐逸淡淡睨了他一眼，笑了：“证据，不巧，还真有。”　　“其实，这首诗真正的名字，叫《老福王忆靖康耻》。”　　“是福王爷前些日子出京都巡视京都三十六营时，我赠予福王的。”　　听到这话，唐画猛地抬起头看向唐逸，原本得意的脸，瞬间煞白下来。　　福王？！　　这是唐逸送给福王的诗？怎么可能！　　而听到唐逸的话，全场也是喧嚣起来，议论纷纷，没想到竟然……又反转了。　　“谁是今科状元，给本王滚出来！”　　就在这时，一道怒吼声传遍全场。　　一个穿着黑袍的老人，拎着剑怒气冲冲地进了鹿鸣湖。　　正是老福王！
content_en: Hearing this, not only Tang Yi was confused, but everyone was also confused.Everyone thought that they would see the two brothers compete in talent and compete in poetry. That is the battlefield where the little poetry fairy and the top scholar of Sanyuan should be!But no one expected that there would be such a turn.In an instant, everyone's eyes fell on Tang Yi, shocked, shocked, and relieved.What does Tang painting mean? Are Tang Yi's two poems "The Hairpin-headed Phoenix" plagiarized from his poems?This... this is too exciting, right?Emperor Yanwen stood up suddenly, his face full of astonishment and shock.The prince, Liu Wen, Zhao Ke and others also widened their eyes and their breathing gradually became rapid.If this is true, then instead of slapping Emperor Yan Wen in the face, he directly presses him under his feet and stomps on him!The poems of the little poetry fairy whom the emperor valued most were plagiarized. This is a shocking scandal.Only Tang Jing's eyes were widened at this time, and the hand stroking his long beard was frozen on his chin.He didn't expect that Tang Hua would choose to confront Tang Yi in this way. This made him feel disappointed and suddenly felt uneasy.In the past few days, he had been personally tutoring and supervising Tang Hua, and he had personally written the poems. He knew very well that Tang Hua had never written these two poems.Kong Shilan's pretty face also changed drastically in an instant, and she was shocked by Tang Hua's words.If what Tang Hua said is true, then today's winner will be Tang Hua... No, that's not right, the title was something she came up with on the spur of the moment, and it was only decided when she took the stage today. How could Tang Hua write the poem first?Is it possible that Tang paintings can predict the future?She subconsciously looked at Tang Yi, only to see that the smile on Tang Yi's mouth was full of playfulness and ridicule.Seeing Tang Yi's expression, Kong Shilan suddenly felt at ease for some reason."Tang Hua, Tang Hua, it seems that I still think too highly of you. Your methods are so low-level." Tang Yi folded his hands and looked down at Tang Hua: "The evil person complained first, you are really good at it! Plagiarism? I haven't even pursued you for plagiarizing me, but you bit me first, right?" When Tang Hua heard this, he sneered and didn't panic at all.He cupped his hands in the direction of Emperor Yan Wen and said, "I am the number one scholar in the Three Yuan exams appointed by His Majesty. Do I still need to copy you?" After saying this, he pointed at Tang Yi sharply and raised his voice a little higher."But you, when I was writing poems for Miss Kong a few days ago, you stole my manuscript and made a lot of nonsense here. You... are the plagiarist!" Upon hearing this, the whole place was boiling!"What? These two poems were plagiarized by Tang Yi?" "Fuck, why did I step down? I actually gave in to a plagiarist?" "Plagiarism is shameless, what a little poet, it is simply a shame to my literary world in Dayan." "Damn it, what are you talking about?What?Xiao Shixian knows how to plagiarize, I think your brains are broken." "Bah, my brother can't plagiarize, plagiarism is a puppy!" "..." Many people were originally dissatisfied with Tang Yi, but now they had an outlet, and all their anger was vented towards Tang Yi.Some people were accusing, scolding, and cursing. Of course, veteran general Di Cang and others also jumped out to speak for Tang Yi, rolling up their sleeves and fighting the whole audience... The scene was in chaos for a while!Even Long Zhan, who was watching the show, looked a little stiff at this time. This show was interesting!The main theme is an unexpected one, hahaha... Qin Yu and Yu Wenfeng stood on the stage and looked at each other. They both suddenly felt that they were a little redundant.How about you finish the fight first?You finish beating us first before continuing!Emperor Yanwen looked at this scene, and Emperor Yanwen was a little confused. How could a game that was originally a sure win suddenly become a hodgepodge?"That's enough! Shut up, everyone." He shouted.The originally noisy Luming Lake gradually became quiet.Emperor Yanwen looked at Tang Yi and said angrily: "He said you plagiarized? What happened?" Tang Yi plagiarized, but he didn't believe a word of it.Tang Yi wrote poems for him and the old general, but they were all improvised topics. Tang Yi also wrote poems they were satisfied with on the spot. Do you call this plagiarism?Tang Yi met Emperor Yanwen's gaze, shrugged and said, "What's going on? You can't afford to lose." "The "Poetry of Admonition" he wrote in the previous imperial examination was a plagiarism of my poem." "But with this poem, he got His Majesty to appoint him as the number one scholar in the third yuan. Then, he relied on itWith his identity as the number one scholar, he can confidently accuse me of plagiarism."After all, ordinary people know who to believe at a glance, between a little poet who has no name and no status, and a number one scholar appointed by His Majesty San Yuan."Tang Yi's voice was calm, but his words sounded like thunder in the audience.What?!Are Tang paintings the real plagiarists?The "Poetry of Admonition" he wrote for the imperial examination was actually plagiarized from Tang Yi's?This...this is even more awesome than Tang Yi's plagiarism!"Tang Yi, shut up!" Tang Jing stood up instantly, pointed at Tang Yi and scolded him angrily."Tang Yi, you little thief, don't talk nonsense!" "You are outrageous, you are blatantly framed." "Tang Yi, we were all present when Tang Hua wrote the "Poetry of Admonition" that day, how could it be plagiarism!" "..." Liu Wen, Zhao Ke and other ministers also stood up and yelled at Tang Yi.Tang Yi copied Tang paintings, which was a shocking scandal. They were happy to see it happen, after all, it was Emperor Yanwen's face.But if Tang Painting plagiarized Tang Yi, it would not be a scandal, it would be fatal!On that day, Tang Hua wrote the "Poetry of Admonition", and they all used this poem to almost ride on Emperor Yanwen's face to speak out, making Emperor Yanwen furious.Now if it is confirmed that this poem is plagiarized... Haha, then they will probably have to line up and play what Tang Yi said about the nine tribes entertainment with the emperor.Emperor Yanwen looked at the anxious ministers and then at Tang Hua.
